Deploy a vector control intervention in an OpenMalaria scenario

Source: R/xml_export.R
deploy_OM_vector_control.Rd

Writes the deployment of an intervention defined with define_OM_vector_control: one OpenMalaria <deployment> containing all its GVI components (one per effect, or one merged component), so that all effects reach the same people, with one <deploy> per campaign of schedule.

For dummy-host interventions, it also writes the host-seeking killing: one dummy host per campaign (addNonHumanHosts, with its decays in nonHumanHostsModifications; see define_OM_vector_control), which needs OpenMalaria schema >= 46. Such an intervention is deployed once, with the whole schedule; subpop, cumulative, minAge and maxAge are rejected (the dummy hosts assume campaigns covering the whole population at the schedule coverages).

Usage

deploy_OM_vector_control(
  baseList,
  name,
  schedule,
  end_date = NULL,
  subpop = NULL,
  cumulative = FALSE,
  minAge = NULL,
  maxAge = NULL
)

Arguments

baseList

openMalariaUtilities baseList, after define_OM_vector_control().

name

Name of the intervention given to (or printed by) define_OM_vector_control().

schedule

Data frame with one row per campaign: date ("YYYY-MM-DD", increasing) and coverage (numbers in [0, 1] or placeholders such as "@cov2021@"), e.g. from om_campaigns; or a continuous schedule from om_continuous (deployment at target ages; standard model, without cumulative, minAge, maxAge).

end_date

Optional end of the simulated period ("YYYY-MM-DD"): the dummy hosts of dummy-host interventions last until then (otherwise 100 years). It can also be kept in the schedule (om_campaigns(end_date = ); if both are given, they must agree).

subpop

Optional sub-population id suffix: the deployment is restricted to the sub-population "<name>-<subpop>" (restrictToSubPop). This and the next arguments: standard model only.

cumulative

Logical (default FALSE): cumulative coverage (cumulativeCoverage, people already covered are not redeployed), measured on "<name>-<subpop>" or the first component.

minAge, maxAge

Optional age limits of the deployment, in years (numbers or placeholders): both or neither (all ages), e.g. minAge = 0, maxAge = 5 for under-fives. Several age groups: one deploy per group.

Value

The updated baseList.

See also

define_OM_vector_control
